$comment: Machine-readable index of the fastn agent skills in this repo. Fetch this file first, pick a skill, then GET its `zip` (or its `skill_md` + `references`) and drop the folder into your agent's skills directory.

claude-ai: upload the .skill file at Customize > Skills > Add
claude-desktop: upload the .skill file at Customize > Skills > Add
claude-cowork: upload the .skill file at Customize > Skills > Add

skills.name: gateway
skills.description: Operating manual for the fastn gateway - clear its required first read, pick and install the right fastn skill, and keep the installed copy in sync with the published version. Use whenever a task touches a fastn connector, integration, workflow, sync, widget, automation, or any external app reached through fastn.

skills.name: integration-builder
skills.description: Plan, map, build, and verify fastn integrations and workflows through the fastn Workflow MCP, in four phases - PLAN, MAP, BUILD, VERIFY. Use to sync, integrate, connect, or migrate data between systems, or to build or modify any fastn workflow, automate on an app event, schedule a sync, or expose a webhook.

skills.name: connector-builder
skills.description: Production knowledge base for building and debugging fastn connectors through the fastn Connector MCP. Covers REST, GraphQL, MCP-protocol, FTP/FTPS/SFTP, DB, gRPC, and AWS Lambda connectors; every auth strategy; action input/output contracts; webhook configs. Use whenever creating, editing, testing, or debugging a fastn connector, auth method, action, or webhook.

skills.name: unified-api
skills.description: Configure and use the fastn Unified API through the fastn Workflow MCP - a platform-global catalog of categories with canonical entities that execute across whichever providers each org has connected. Use when asked to create a unified API, add a category/entity, map a connector into a unified entity, or debug UNIFIED_* errors.

skills.name: workflow-verifier
skills.description: Verify a fastn workflow, trigger, widget, or whole use case actually works - end to end, with runtime evidence - through the fastn Workflow MCP. Use when asked to verify, test, QA, or health-check an existing workflow or integration, and after any workflow/trigger/widget/config change.
